links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

results.description: List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of documents available. MongoDB Cloud omits this value if `includeCount` is set to `false`. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact.

country.description: Two-character alphabetical string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user's geographic location. This parameter uses the ISO 3166-1a2 code format.

createdAt.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud created the current account. This value is in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

firstName.description: First or given name that belongs to the MongoDB Cloud user.

lastAuth.description: Date and time when the current account last authenticated. This value is in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

lastName.description: Last name, family name, or surname that belongs to the MongoDB Cloud user.

mobileNumber.description: Mobile phone number that belongs to the MongoDB Cloud user.

invitationCreatedAt.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud sent the invitation. MongoDB Cloud represents this timestamp in ISO 8601 format in UTC.

invitationExpiresAt.description: Date and time when the invitation from MongoDB Cloud expires. MongoDB Cloud represents this timestamp in ISO 8601 format in UTC.

inviterUsername.description: Username of the MongoDB Cloud user who sent the invitation to join the organization.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user.

orgMembershipStatus.description: String enum that indicates whether the MongoDB Cloud user has a pending invitation to join the organization or they are already active in the organization.

roles.description: One or more project-level roles assigned to the MongoDB Cloud user.

username.description: Email address that represents the username of the MongoDB Cloud user.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.
